reuse.why: Builds on the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard, saveLinkedAccount and linkExternalAccount, so every provider gets the flag; the new clearAccountLink repeats unlinkAccount's reset instead of being shared with it.

duplication.why: clearAccountLink copies the db.updateAccount field reset from unlinkAccount without making unlinkAccount use it, and the replaced-ids loop is written twice inside saveLinkedAccount (upgrade branch and new-account branch).

placement.why: Detection lives in the shared guard and the takeover in the shared save step in accounts/app.ts, where the linking logic already is; the guard named assert...NotLinked now also returns the accounts to take over from.

scope.why: Only threads the flag through the existing link helpers and adds the release note.

maintainability.why: One guard and one save path keep the behaviour consistent across providers, but the misleading guard name and the second copy of the reset fields will need care.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts clearAccountLink re-implements the local reset inside unlinkAccount instead of extracting it and having unlinkAccount use it

disguised_duplication.where: accounts/app.ts clearAccountLink: unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount reset moved into a new, differently named function while the original stays inline in unlinkAccount
